name: dsh-chime-alerts
description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: sound alerts for ten agent events — completion, subagent completion, background-job completion, approval, plugin approval, question, plan-review, goal-blocked, interruption, and background-job failure (browser Web Audio + system beep, per-event toggles/sounds/volume, quick-mute button)

description.zh: 十类 Agent 事件的声音提醒：任务完成 / 子任务完成 / 后台任务完成 / 需要授权 / 插件授权 / Agent 提问 / 计划评审 / 目标受阻 / 其他打断 / 后台任务失败。浏览器 Web Audio 合成音 + 系统蜂鸣混合发声，每个事件独立开关、独立声音、独立音量，侧栏工作区快捷静音。
description.en: Sound alerts for ten agent events: completion, subagent completion, background-job completion, approval, plugin approval, question, plan-review, goal-blocked, interruption, and background-job failure. Hybrid playback (browser Web Audio + system beep) with per-event toggles, sounds, and volume, plus workspace quick-mute buttons.
